string.text: F5: revert section | F6: save | F7: hide (keep weather and time) | Esc: close | weather_editor: reopen
Enable learning mode to see explanations for every field, parameter and button in the editor.
The in-game editor for weather cycles and time keyframes.
The status line reports the current action, save result or an error.
Creates a new weather file with the entered name, using the current keyframe as its base.
Adds a new keyframe to the current weather at the time selected on the timeline.
Fullscreen preview. Esc or F7 return to the editor. In the editor F7 hides it and keeps the weather and time fixed in the game (no file is written; F6 saves).

Saves all time sections of the current weather cycle, including tree sway strength, to its .ltx file. Also saves global rain tilt and speed boost factors to noirWeatherEffect.ltx while preserving its other settings.
Restores the selected time section and global rain tilt and speed boost settings to their state when editing began or after the last save.
Closes the editor, ends the editing session and returns the game to normal operation.
Color picker: drag in the large field for saturation and brightness, or on the strip for hue.
The weather cycle (.ltx) currently being edited and rendered in the game.
A time keyframe in the current cycle. Selecting it moves the editor exactly to that time.
The sky cubemap texture. A matching #small texture must also exist.
The cloud-layer texture drawn over the sky and animated by the weather system.
The ambient section containing nature sounds and environmental effects for this time of day.
The sun and lens-flare definition selected from the suns configuration.
The lightning collection used during storms. Selecting none disables lightning.
Time of day from 00:00 to 23:59. Values are blended between adjacent keyframes.
Name of the new weather file without the .ltx extension. Use letters, digits, _ or -.
Rotates the sky cubemap around the horizon from 0 to 360 degrees.
Maximum scene rendering distance. Higher values increase visibility and rendering cost.
Fog density from 0 to 1: 0 disables fog and 1 gives maximum density.
Distance at which fog almost completely covers the scene. It must not exceed the far plane.
Rain intensity from 0 to 1. It affects drop count and related weather effects.

Wind speed for the selected weather time section. Drives tree sway and, with dynamic rain wind enabled, rain tilt and speed boost together with gust strength. 0 removes these wind effects. Tree sway, rain tilt and rain speed boost each have their own multiplier.

Horizontal wind direction from 0 to 360 degrees in the selected time section. Trees and rain use the same direction. Transitions between sections take the shortest path across 0/360. Rain requires dynamic rain wind to be enabled. Direction alone does not increase wind strength.
Duration of a single lightning flash.
Sun-shaft intensity. The visible result depends on the active renderer and shaders.
Brightness of soft-water effects near shores and underwater objects. It does not control wave height.
RGB multiplier for the sky. A value of 1 preserves the original texture channel.
RGBA cloud multiplier: RGB changes color while A controls layer density and visibility.
RGB fog color gradually covering distant geometry.
RGB tint applied to rain drops and related effects.
Base ambient illumination filling areas not reached by direct light.
Indirect light color from the sky hemisphere; A is used as a renderer correction value.
RGB color and brightness of direct sunlight.
Vertical sun angle: approximately 0 degrees is the horizon and -90 is the highest position.
Horizontal sun azimuth from -180 to 180 degrees.
Ready. Changes are previewed immediately; Save writes the current .ltx.
Sun definition changed in real time: %s
Color picker: drag in the field and hue strip; RGB updates in real time.
Cannot add section: this time already exists.
Added new time section [%s]. Save weather to write it to disk.
Cannot create weather. Use a unique name containing only letters, digits, _ or -.
Created and selected new weather file: %s
Fullscreen preview. Move and look around using the game controls. Press F7 to return to the editor.
ERROR: weather config was not saved. See the log.
Keyframe reverted to its last saved/opened state.

Tree sway strength in the selected time section (trees_amplitude), from 0 to 1. 0 stops sway; 0.5 gives half normal strength; 1 gives full normal strength. Wind speed and direction are set separately. A missing key defaults to 1. Out-of-range values are clamped to 0–1. Saved in the current weather file.

Wind-driven rain tilt multiplier (tilt_multiplier), range 0–3. 0 removes wind tilt; 1 gives normal tilt; 2 doubles it; 3 triples it. These are multiplier values, not degrees. The resulting physical tilt is capped at 80 degrees. Requires dynamic rain wind. Shared by all weather cycles; saved under [dynamic_wind] in noirWeatherEffect.ltx.
Weather saved, but saving rain settings to noirWeatherEffect.ltx failed.

Wind-driven rain fall speed boost (speed_wind_multiplier), range 0–10. 0 keeps base speed. At maximum wind influence, 1 doubles speed and 1.5 gives 2.5 times base speed. No change applies without wind or with dynamic rain wind disabled. This is not an independent base speed control. Shared by all weather cycles; saved under [dynamic_wind] in noirWeatherEffect.ltx.
Global [custom_lightning] settings. Sliders affect subsequent strikes. Select a lightning collection on this tab for testing. Test bursts follow the player view; the editor stays open.
Editing [custom_lightning]: changes apply to subsequent strikes.
Settings can be edited and saved. Enable enable_custom_lightning for runtime effects and testing.
Asset not applied: choose a particle from the list and check the sound path without .ogg. An empty sound path disables it.
Particle and sound applied to subsequent strikes.
Could not save [custom_lightning]. See the game log for details.
Restored lightning settings from the start of editing or the last save.
Burst not started: enable_custom_lightning and a nonempty collection are required; wait for the previous burst to finish.
Weather and lightning tabs. Changes stay in memory when switching. Save and Revert affect the active tab.
Saves only [custom_lightning] to noirWeatherEffect.ltx. Other settings, rain sections and comments are preserved.
Restores only lightning settings from when editing began or this page was last saved.
Open the list and type part of a name or path. None disables the particle.
Open the list and type part of a name or path. Click [>] to listen, or click the name to select it. None disables the sound.
Validates and applies the selected impact particle and sound, without writing the file.
One burst in the player viewing direction using current settings and the collection selected on this tab. The editor stays open. Direct damage is disabled for this test burst.
0 allows one strike; 1 enables bursts of multiple strikes. [enable_multi_strikes]
Chance of a burst instead of a single strike. Requires multiple strikes to be enabled. [multi_strike_chance]
Maximum strikes in a burst, from 2 to 8. The actual number is random. [max_simultaneous]
Chance that an additional strike starts from the first strike cloud position. Requires a burst. [same_location_chance]
Chance of branching to a different hit point when strikes share a cloud. Otherwise they repeat the same hit. [branching_chance]
Lightning source height as a multiplier of the current view distance. [height_factor]
Lightning scale factor. Together with cloud height and distance it changes bolt size. [size_multiplier]
Chance of choosing the near distance range. Near plus medium chances cannot exceed 100%; the remainder is far strikes. [prob_near]
Chance of choosing the medium distance range. Far strikes use the remaining probability. [prob_medium]
Minimum horizontal distance from the camera for a near strike. [dist_near_min]
Maximum horizontal distance for a near strike. [dist_near_max]
Minimum horizontal distance for a medium strike. [dist_medium_min]
Maximum horizontal distance for a medium strike. [dist_medium_max]
Minimum horizontal distance for a far strike. [dist_far_min]
Maximum horizontal distance for a far strike. [dist_far_max]
Thunder near sound distance. Distance-based pitch and volume changes start beyond this distance. [thunder_range_min]
Thunder far sound distance; must exceed the near distance. [thunder_range_max]
Distance over which thunder reaches its far pitch and volume, measured beyond the near sound distance. [thunder_fade_dist]
0 keeps the pitch unchanged. Values closer to 1 lower the pitch of distant thunder more. [thunder_pitch_drop]
0 adds no extra volume reduction. Values closer to 1 make distant thunder quieter. [thunder_vol_drop]
Near sound distance for the separate impact sound. [strike_snd_range_min]
Far sound distance for the separate impact sound; must exceed the near distance. [strike_snd_range_max]
Direct damage power at a lightning hit. 0 disables direct damage. The test burst does not apply this damage. [strike_damage_power]
Direct damage radius around a lightning hit. 0 disables it. The test burst does not apply direct damage. [strike_damage_radius]
Lightning collection for the test burst. On the lightning page this selection does not change the weather time section. Select a nonempty collection for testing.
Test burst started in the player viewing direction.
Changes apply in real time. In learning mode, hover a parameter to read its explanation.
New weather file: enter a name without .ltx. Two initial sections will be created.
Invalid number. Use a decimal point or comma and confirm with Enter.
Unsaved changes on this tab | Changes apply in real time
No unsaved changes on this tab
Type part of a resource name or path. The list filters immediately, ignoring case. The current selection and None remain available. Searching does not change the selected resource.
